comments: This is a browser-based simulation and design-inspection tool, not a diagnostic or WCAG pass/fail test. Uploaded images are processed locally and are not sent to a server.
features: Browser-based image simulator for protan, deutan, tritan, and achromatopsia views. It offers Brettel, Viénot, and Machado methods, adjustable severity, grayscale difference maps, and downloadable PNGs. Images are processed locally.
title: Color Blindness Simulator
